description: Implement the multi-tenant authentication system using AWS Cognito patterns, the core data models with DynamoDB single-table design, and the shared middleware for tenant isolation. This forms the security and data foundation for the entire platform.
steps: Create packages/shared/src/types/tenant.ts with comprehensive multi-tenant types: Tenant (id, name, type: school|university|institute|government, config, subscription tier, domain), TenantUser, TenantContext, TenantConfig (branding, features enabled, AI quotas)

Create packages/shared/src/types/user.ts with user types: User, UserProfile, UserRole (student|teacher|admin|principal|governance|parent), UserPermissions, and role-based access control (RBAC) definitions
Create packages/shared/src/types/auth.ts with auth types: AuthToken, AuthSession, CognitoConfig per tenant, MFA settings
Create packages/shared/src/types/dpi.ts with DPI integration types: APAARProfile, DigiLockerDocument, AcademicBankCredit, ConsentArtifact (DPDP compliant)
Create apps/api/src/middleware/auth.ts - JWT verification middleware that extracts tenant context from Cognito tokens, validates tenant isolation, enforces RBAC
Create apps/api/src/middleware/tenant.ts - Tenant resolution middleware that identifies tenant from subdomain/header, loads tenant config, injects TenantContext
Create apps/api/src/middleware/rateLimit.ts - Per-tenant rate limiting with configurable thresholds based on subscription tier
Create apps/api/src/models/base.ts - DynamoDB single-table design base model with partition key (TENANT#tenantId), sort key patterns, GSI definitions for access patterns
Create apps/api/src/models/tenant.ts - Tenant CRUD operations with DynamoDB DocumentClient, including tenant provisioning, configuration updates, usage tracking
Create apps/api/src/models/user.ts - User model with tenant-scoped access patterns, profile management, role assignments
Create apps/api/src/handlers/auth/register.ts - Multi-tenant user registration Lambda: validates tenant, creates Cognito user in tenant user pool group, stores profile in DynamoDB
Create apps/api/src/handlers/auth/login.ts - Authentication Lambda: authenticates against Cognito, returns JWT with tenant claims, logs session
Create apps/api/src/handlers/auth/refresh.ts - Token refresh Lambda with session validation
Create apps/api/src/handlers/tenants/create.ts - Tenant onboarding Lambda: provisions new tenant (school/university), sets up configuration, initializes Cognito group
Create apps/api/src/handlers/tenants/manage.ts - Tenant management Lambda: update config, manage subscription, view usage analytics
Create packages/shared/src/utils/encryption.ts - Data encryption utilities for PII (DPDP compliance): encrypt/decrypt helpers using AWS KMS patterns
Create packages/shared/src/utils/consent.ts - Consent management utilities for DPDP Act compliance: consent collection, verification, withdrawal
Create apps/api/src/handlers/auth/__tests__/auth.test.ts - Unit tests for auth handlers using Vitest with mocked AWS services
Create apps/api/src/handlers/tenants/__tests__/tenants.test.ts - Unit tests for tenant management handlers
Create apps/api/src/middleware/__tests__/middleware.test.ts - Unit tests for auth, tenant, and rate limit middleware
acceptance_criteria: All TypeScript files compile without errors in apps/api and packages/shared
Unit tests for auth handlers pass with mocked Cognito and DynamoDB
Unit tests for tenant management pass
Middleware correctly extracts tenant context and enforces isolation
DPDP consent types properly model consent lifecycle (collect, verify, withdraw)
DynamoDB single-table design supports all required access patterns with proper key structure
Rate limiting is configurable per tenant subscription tier
findings: All 119 tests pass (82 API, 37 shared). Removed paths alias from api tsconfig.json - the workspace:* link resolves @learning-os/shared via node_modules at build time, while vitest uses a resolve alias to point to source. Shared package needed @types/node for crypto module. Removed duplicate PermissionAction/PermissionCondition types from auth.ts (kept in user.ts which has the comprehensive RBAC definitions). vitest.config.ts files added to both packages for test running.
